name: Balloon
rows: Press the Jump button or the space bar to jump over the obstacles.
Press the Dash button or the Shift key while jumping to dash in the air.
While looking down, press the Jump button to descend certain terrain.
Press the Attack button or the left mouse button to launch a normal attack.

This is a world created just for you. 
Unleash your potential and grow stronger for the Goddess Squad.
Let's take care of the Raptures around while gathering information.
With this amount of analyzed data, I should be able to open the locked door.
But... the fact remains that it must be eliminated.
This is a strange Rapture. Let's analyze its data.
The signal... belongs to other Raptures.

The signal is coming from deeper in.
All right, let's follow it.
There's also a door blocking the way here.
Let's search for the signal that the door is pointing to.

This Rapture's core data is also transmitting recovery data for the Glass Slippers
as well as the coordinates of other Raptures.

Are they exchanging coordinates?
... Well, it's just one more target to deal with.
This time, I need two types of data.
The signals are split between above and below, so let's go look for them.
This time, it's transmitting the coordinates of four signal data points.
Let's locate the signal data first.
Is this where I was moved after being ambushed and knocked out?
Why has the data for the damaged Glass Slippers been restored?
Let's explore this place for the time being.
It's the signal from the Glass Slippers?
Why does a Rapture have the signal of the Glass Slippers?
I need to figure out what exactly the Raptures are planning.

The signal from the Glass Slippers is getting stronger.
That means the source must be nearby.
No matter what the Raptures are up to, I will definitely crush them.
This Rapture... is receiving the same signal that I received.
It's even receiving data from a Nikke.

!! Danger Zone !!
The path ahead is extremely dangerous.
Even if you reach the end, there is nothing there.
You are advised to turn back.
